in_sample_reference.note: IN-SAMPLE (fit and scored on the same 1985+ window) — reference only, NOT the headline. See out-of-sample stats above.

measured.caveat: Out-of-sample (leave-one-recession-out) on N≈3 endogenous recessions — even the OOS estimate is underpowered; the Jeffreys interval on the catch rate is wide. Vintage (initial-release) data for legs with ALFRED coverage (ICSA/UMCSENT/PAYEMS/INDPRO); the rest use revised data so their leads are an upper bound. COVID-2020 is exogenous and excluded from lead stats.

lag_passport.note: Publication lag is a per-leg schedule (PUB_LAG_M) applied symmetrically on the live and validation paths (macro-regime-6). Daily leading legs (SPY/curve/HY/claims) are knowable intramonth → lag 0; monthly hard data carry their real release lag (1-2 months). `extra_uniform_lag_m` is any additional uniform stress lag on top (default 0).

business_cycle.caveat: Effective sample is tiny (~7 modern US recessions, ~3 point-in-time) — a recession-RISK timeline, not a crash oracle. Lead times are measured against NBER dates; see the validation report.
business_cycle.caveat_zh: 有效样本极小（现代美国衰退约 7 次，可点对点回溯约 3 次）——这是衰退“风险”时间线，并非崩盘预言。领先时长以 NBER 日期为准，详见验证报告。

systemic_stress.evidence: OFR Financial Stress Index: a daily 33-variable global stress gauge with functional (credit / equity valuation / safe assets / funding / volatility) and regional (US / other-advanced / EM) decomposition. A coincident gauge — it names the stress CHANNEL when markets move as one; display + an optional risk-OFF gate, never cross-sectional alpha.

drawdown_risk.basis: macro/credit composite (recession_risk, NFCI, EBP, HY OAS)

stat_passport.definition: max peak-to-trough SPY decline over the next 63 trading days
stat_passport.note: Re-measured on the leak-free PIT ('release') frame with the jobless-claims labor leg; replaces the stale 8/26/36/38 (Sahm-era, revised-frame) table. Live gauge fires on 'latest'; its bands are within CI of PIT. Overlap-inflated N + episode-driven high/extreme bands — a risk read, not a crash oracle.

positioning.name: S&P 500 futures speculators标普500 期货投机者
positioning.label: normal正常
positioning.tip: Net bets of speculative futures traders on the S&P 500, as % of all open contracts (CFTC weekly data). Deeply negative + low percentile = everyone's already short — fuel for squeezes. Very high = crowded long. Today: -2.0% of open contracts, 43th percentile of 30 years (as of 2026-07-14, 3-day reporting lag).投机性期货交易者在标普500上的净头寸，占全部未平仓合约的百分比（CFTC 周度数据）。深度为负 + 低百分位 = 大家都已做空 — 逼空燃料。极高 = 拥挤做多。 今日：占未平仓合约 -2.0%，30年内第 43 百分位（截至 2026-07-14，报告延迟3天）。

positioning.name: 10-yr Treasury futures speculators10年期美债 期货投机者
positioning.label: extreme short极度做空
positioning.verdict: everyone is already short — most extreme in our records; reversal fuel大家都已做空 — 我们记录中最极端；反转燃料
positioning.tip: Speculators' net position in 10-year Treasury futures. Extreme shorts have historically preceded falling yields (bond rallies), and vice versa. Today: -15.7% of open contracts, 5th percentile of 30 years (as of 2026-07-14, 3-day reporting lag).投机者在10年期美债期货上的净头寸。历史上极端做空往往先于收益率下行（债券上涨），反之亦然。 今日：占未平仓合约 -15.7%，30年内第 5 百分位（截至 2026-07-14，报告延迟3天）。

positioning.name: US Dollar futures speculators美元 期货投机者
positioning.label: leaning long偏向做多
positioning.verdict: above normal, nothing extreme高于正常，但不极端
positioning.tip: Speculators' net position on the dollar index. Extremes tend to mark dollar turning points, which matter for commodities and foreign earnings. Today: +24.7% of open contracts, 60th percentile of 30 years (as of 2026-07-14, 3-day reporting lag).投机者在美元指数上的净头寸。极端值往往标志美元的转折点，对大宗商品与海外盈利至关重要。 今日：占未平仓合约 +24.7%，30年内第 60 百分位（截至 2026-07-14，报告延迟3天）。

positioning.name: Gold futures speculators黄金 期货投机者
positioning.label: crowded long拥挤做多
positioning.verdict: everyone is already long — crowded; late to join大家都已做多 — 拥挤；加入已晚
positioning.tip: Speculators' net position in gold futures. Near the 100th percentile = the most crowded gold trade in decades — vulnerable to shakeouts. Today: +48.7% of open contracts, 94th percentile of 30 years (as of 2026-07-14, 3-day reporting lag).投机者在黄金期货上的净头寸。接近第100百分位 = 数十年来最拥挤的黄金交易 — 易遭洗盘。 今日：占未平仓合约 +48.7%，30年内第 94 百分位（截至 2026-07-14，报告延迟3天）。

positioning.name: Pro fund managers专业基金经理
positioning.label: crowded invested拥挤重仓
positioning.verdict: managers are nearly all-in — crowded; late to join基金经理几乎满仓 — 拥挤；加入已晚
positioning.tip: NAAIM weekly survey of professional active managers' stock exposure (0 = all cash, 100 = fully invested, >100 = leveraged). Extremes are contrarian. Today: 96, 91th percentile since 2006 (as of 2026-07-15).NAAIM 对专业主动型管理者股票敞口的周度调查（0 = 全现金，100 = 满仓，>100 = 加杠杆）。极端值具反向意义。今日：96，2006年以来第 91 百分位（截至 2026-07-15）。

positioning.name: Options hedging mood期权对冲情绪
positioning.label: heavy hedging大量对冲
positioning.verdict: lots of downside protection being bought — fear elevated大量买入下行保护 — 恐慌升高
positioning.tip: Put/call volume ratio on S&P index options, computed from CBOE's chain: bearish bets ÷ bullish bets traded today. Above ~1.3 = heavy hedging; below ~0.8 = complacency. Today: 1.53 (as of 2026-07-19). A young series — labels are based on standard thresholds until enough history accrues.标普指数期权的看跌/看涨成交量比，由 CBOE 期权链计算：今日看空押注 ÷ 看多押注。高于约1.3 = 大量对冲；低于约0.8 = 自满。今日：1.53（截至 2026-07-19）。这是一个较新的序列 — 在积累足够历史前，标签基于标准阈值。

positioning.name: Market-maker effect做市商效应
positioning.label: amplifying swings放大波动
positioning.verdict: market-makers' hedging adds fuel to moves — expect bigger swings both ways做市商对冲为波动添柴 — 预期双向波动更大
positioning.tip: Estimated dealer gamma (GEX) from the S&P options chain, standard assumption (dealers long calls/short puts). Positive = their hedging dampens market moves; negative = it amplifies them. Today: -5bn per 1% move (as of 2026-07-19). An estimate, not ground truth.由标普期权链估算的做市商 gamma（GEX），采用标准假设（做市商持有多头看涨/空头看跌）。正值 = 其对冲抑制市场波动；负值 = 放大波动。今日：每1%波动 -5十亿 （截至 2026-07-19）。这是估算，并非真实值。

positioning.name: Fear gauge恐慌指标
positioning.label: normal正常
positioning.tip: VIX (30-day expected volatility) ÷ VIX3M (3-month). Below ~0.9 = calm; near/above 1.0 = the market fears the immediate future more than the distant one — the classic stress signature. Today: 0.914, 59th percentile since 2006.VIX（30天预期波动率）÷ VIX3M（3个月）。低于约0.9 = 平静；接近/高于1.0 = 市场对近期的恐惧超过对远期 — 经典的压力特征。今日：0.914，2006年以来第 59 百分位。
